title: Bass players and hiring for Buddy
summary: Buddy had trouble with bassists and Pat hired and fired them.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Did he prefer the electric bass?

Well you know I think when Joel DeBartolo and Ron Paley came on that when Paul Congelo we went to the electric bass. We had a lot of problems with bass players. There were times there when I was hiring and firing so many guys, and some really good guys, but you just couldn’t get the right guy. We got Joel DeBartolo finally, we got Joel on there for a long length of time. But there were just times when you couldn’t get a bass player that Buddy could agree with. I always felt, I’ve felt that Buddy always wanted sometimes a bass player who would kind of go with him if he wanted to move the music up just a little bit in tempo, and not hold him back. You know if you get a bass player that says no, this is where the time is I’m going to stay here. I don’t think he always liked that, because sometimes he’d like to push the chart just a tiny step.
Did you ever let a guy go that Buddy disagreed with? Like why did you let him go?
